en.content: Our paper "Developing urban building energy models for shanghai city with multi-source open data" has been recognized as Highly Cited Paper in Web of Science!
Our paper "Demand Flexibility of Pre-Cooling Strategies for City-Scale Buildings Through Urban Building Energy Modeling" was published in Buildings.
Our paper "CityEL: A web-based platform to support city-scale building energy efficiency based on AutoBPS" was published in Sustainable Cities and Society.
Our paper "UAV-BIM-BEM: An automatic unmanned aerial vehicles-based building energy model generation platform" was published in Energy and Buildings.
Our paper "A review of current research on occupant-centric control for improving comfort and energy efficiency" was published in Building Simulation.
Our paper "Developing urban building energy models for shanghai city with multi-source open data" was published in Sustainable Cities and Society.
Our paper "Analysis of Peak Demand Reduction and Energy Saving in a Mixed-Use Community through Urban Building Energy Modeling" was published in Energies.
Our paper "Economic analysis of rooftop photovoltaics system under different shadowing conditions for 20 cities in China" was published in Building Simulation.
Our paper "Enhanced Operation of Ice Storage System for Peak Load Management in Shopping Malls across Diverse Climate Zones" was published in Sustainability.
Our paper "An emergency aircraft evacuation simulation considering passenger overtaking and luggage retrieval" was published in Reliability Engineering & System Safety.
